name: Dumbbell Incline Y-Raise
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie chest down with feet planted.
Let the dumbbells hang beneath your shoulders with your thumbs pointing forward.
Lift both arms diagonally forward and outward to form a Y in line with your torso.
Pause briefly squeezing your upper back, then lower the dumbbells smoothly back below your shoulders.
tips: Keep your thumbs pointed upward and your chest resting on the pad.
Keep your neck long as your shoulder blades turn upward with your arms.
